# MM-P2-L1-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Scope
- This document defines preventative maintenance tasks, acceptance criteria, and records for the Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) used in plant P2, line P2-L1.
- Tasks are intended to be performed by trained maintenance technicians in accordance with governing procedures: ECN-2026-023, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-02.
- The manual covers mechanical clamp inspection and lubrication of the main roll bearing, explaining rationale, method, and documentation requirements. Repairs beyond scope shall be referred to engineering under ECN-2026-023.

Tools
- Torque wrench capable of the required setting for the mandrel clamp. Verify calibration traceable to plant calibration program per SOP-P2-L1-01.
- Standard hand tools for access panels and fastener removal as required by SOP-P2-L1-02.
- Clean lint-free rags and approved solvent for surface cleaning.
- Grease gun compatible with machine lubrication fittings and the grease specified in SOP-P2-L1-02.
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P2-L1-01.

Procedure
Background and rationale
- The mandrel clamp maintains axial position and radial engagement of the ring during forming operations. Correct clamp bolt torque ensures consistent clamp preload, prevents slippage, and avoids localized overload on mating components.
- The main roll bearing supports the primary rolling element and requires consistent lubrication to prevent metal-to-metal contact and progressive wear. Lubrication interval is based on operating load and environment; adhere to the specified service interval to reduce bearing fatigue risk.

Step sequence
- Prepare the machine following SOP-P2-L1-01 and lockout/tagout per SOP-P2-L1-02 before accessing the mandrel clamp or main roll bearing areas.
- Clean exterior of the mandrel clamp assembly using approved solvent and lint-free rags. Inspect surfaces for signs of wear, corrosion, fretting, or deformation. Note any scoring or non-uniform contact patterns.
- Using the calibrated torque wrench, verify the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. If torque is below the specified value, tighten to 430 N·m. If bolt requires torque above 430 N·m to reach specification, stop and escalate per ECN-2026-023 for further engineering assessment.
- After torque confirmation, cycle the clamp through its normal engagement travel by following SOP-P2-L1-01 operational checks (static movement only while in a safe, locked state). Observe for smooth clamping action, consistent seating, and absence of abnormal noises.
- Access the lubrication point for the main roll bearing per machine access panels. Prime the grease gun with the approved lubricant from SOP-P2-L1-02 and purge any air in the line.
- Lubricate the main roll bearing at the established service point. The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 220 hours. Record the service in the maintenance log immediately after completion.
- After lubrication, operate the bearing manually where safe and practical to distribute lubricant. Inspect seals and relubrication fittings for damage or contamination. Replace any compromised seals per SOP-P2-L1-02 and notify engineering under ECN-2026-023 if replacement parts are different from original specification.

Examples and special conditions
- Example: If post-torque inspection reveals uneven clamp seating, mark the affected face and compare to prior inspection records. If repeat occurrence is observed, raise an ECN-2026-023 change request for investigation.
- Example: If grease expelled from bearing seals appears contaminated or shows metal particulate, secure the machine, take a grease sample per SOP-P2-L1-02 sampling protocol, and submit to condition monitoring. Escalate immediately under ECN-2026-023 if wear particles indicate abnormal degradation.

Records to keep
- Maintenance log entry for each task including technician initials, date, time in/out, tasks performed, and observations. Include the exact torque verification statement: mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m.
- Lubrication register entry indicating the main roll bearing lubrication interval adherence: main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 220 hours. Include cumulative hours run since last lubrication as recorded in equipment runtime log per SOP-P2-L1-01.
- Any nonconformances or escalation actions referenced to ECN-2026-023 must be recorded with ECN id and a brief description of the issue.
- Store photographs of clamp condition and bearing seals in the maintenance record when anomalies are observed.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolt torque verification complete and recorded. Acceptance criterion: torque reading matches the specified value and clamp seating is uniform. If torque confirmation cannot be achieved without abnormal tightening, the component is not acceptable until engineering review under ECN-2026-023.
- Main roll bearing lubrication performed within the defined interval and recorded. Acceptance criterion: lubrication entry shows adherence to the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 220 hours and post-lubrication inspection shows seals intact and no contamination.
- No leakage, abnormal noise, or excessive play observed after maintenance actions. If any of these conditions are present, the machine shall not be returned to service until corrective actions are completed and documented per ECN-2026-023.

References
- ECN-2026-023
- SOP-P2-L1-01
- SOP-P2-L1-02

Notes
- Follow training and competency verification requirements in SOP-P2-L1-01 before performing these tasks.
- For part replacement or design changes, submit documentation through ECN-2026-023.
